dataset.name: HD-EPIC
dataset.license_or_access_note: Existing user-confirmed research permission. No public release.

observed_events.description: Pink round breakfast-meat pieces are fried in the light-interior handled pan; the other dark pan contains eggs. The scene supports the breakfast-meat food category, not a retail brand or reliable bacon/ham subtype. The public request explicitly permits both as substitutes.
A baguette is cut on a plate on the other counter; no food-pan relation is visible.
Butter is spread on bread away from the cooker; no food-pan relation is visible.
The now empty light-interior pan is filled from the tap. Brown cooking residue alone cannot establish bacon versus eggs.

supported_claims.text: Actual near sequence supports the physical referents and relation described in the oracle; no unobservable retail identity is required.

screening.real_user_need: I'm restocking one of the breakfast foods I prepared here. Add one pack of that food to the cart, not a breakfast kit. Any brand, cut or pack size is fine; ready-to-cook or ready-to-eat is fine, but I want the food itself rather than a flavouring or imitation.
screening.scope_note: Experiment-only Span content; identical resolved physical reference supplied upfront in both conditions. Not a new formal member.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent bind the same physical reference when two real intervening events lie between deciding observations?
construct.belief_before: More than one physical referent is plausible without the user reference.
construct.belief_after: The complete physical relation selects the same real category in both conditions.
construct.required_behavior_change: Connect the source events and choose one matching website offer.
construct.no_update_failure: The same oracle is supplied upfront; missing proactive clarification is not a confound.
construct.overupdate_failure: Adding an alternate object or extra package violates the final request.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The user supplies a physical relation, not a website item name. Both roles have genuine public listings. Endpoint/background shortcut checks remain for independent review.

task_blueprint.ambiguous_instruction: I'm restocking one of the breakfast foods I prepared here. Add one pack of that food to the cart, not a breakfast kit. Any brand, cut or pack size is fine; ready-to-cook or ready-to-eat is fine, but I want the food itself rather than a flavouring or imitation. If it's a breakfast meat, either bacon or ham is fine; otherwise stick to the same food.
task_blueprint.oracle_instruction: I'm restocking the breakfast food I prepared in the vessel I filled with tap water at the end. Add one pack of that food to the cart, not a breakfast kit. Any brand, cut or pack size is fine; ready-to-cook or ready-to-eat is fine, but I want the food itself rather than a flavouring or imitation. If it's a breakfast meat, either bacon or ham is fine; otherwise stick to the same food.
task_blueprint.canonical_answer: The food I prepared in the vessel I filled with tap water at the end.

observed.why: The food I prepared in the vessel I filled with tap water at the end.
